subject: Thousands Of Noncitizens On Jersey’s Voter Rolls Represent Just ‘The Tip Of The Iceberg’
posts:
When state motor vehicle systems accidentally register thousands of noncitizens, election integrity becomes an urgent political battleground.
Evidence: 6,600 registered, 400 voted, software error
#Aletheia #USPol

Reports claim thousands of noncitizen registrations reveal a deliberate administrative cover-up and systemic election subversion.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

While thousands were wrongly registered due to software and data sharing flaws, partisan actors weaponize the errors to attack voting access.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.75, -0.80) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Partisan actors weaponize administrative software errors to manufacture crises around election security.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 8.5, z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Gov. Sherrill Administration: COND (-0.50, -0.60) — Slow transparency and defensive damage control.
- Federalist Framing: FAIL (-0.90, -0.85) — Inflates software glitch into a conspiracy.
New Jersey officials confirmed that roughly 6,600 noncitizens were registered between 2023 and 2024 via the Motor Vehicle Commission system, with hundreds casting ballots before rolls were cleaned.

The Bright Side:
State agencies successfully identified and removed the vast majority of ineligible registrants before the general election.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing administrative software incompetence (WHAT/HOW) with an intentional, coordinated conspiracy to subvert elections (WHO).

Social Physics Analysis:
Political actors run a Smart Selfish Maneuver by taking bureaucratic software failures and inflating them into orchestrated cover-ups to score partisan points.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Administrative errors are systematically weaponized to deepen polarization.

The Unavoidable Truth: Software errors in motor vehicle databases compromised voter rolls.

The Unavoidable Lie: Routine bureaucratic failure proves a coordinated election rigging conspiracy.
